text: Believe it or not, your body might actually benefit in some weird ways. Here are five surprising positives most people don't know. It helps your heart a little. Light to moderate beer drinkers have a slightly lower risk of heart attacks. That's because beer can improve blood flow and reduce clotting. Just don't overdo it. You'll probably sleep better. Beer has small amounts of magnesium, potassium, and even B vitamins. Together these help your body relax and fall asleep easier. Your bones might get stronger. Beer contains dietary silicon. A mineral that helps build and maintain healthy bones. Stronger bones, less risk of fractures as you age. Your brain gets a mini boost. Some studies suggest moderate beer drinking can lower your risk of dementia. It's the antioxidant.
